goal: Make scripts/bench.py record the Ollama environment and the task timeout in each run's JSON and markdown output, with a unittest for ollama_env().
requirements: Add ollama_env(): a dict of the five OLLAMA_* keys (MAX_LOADED_MODELS, NUM_PARALLEL, KEEP_ALIVE, FLASH_ATTENTION, KV_CACHE_TYPE) from os.environ; missing maps to unset.
Add the per-task timeout to that dict as the integer key task_timeout_s, using the 150 second default bench.py already uses.
Where bench.py writes OUT / stamp-tag.json (near line 300), add a top-level key env holding that dict. Keep all other keys unchanged.
In the markdown written next to the JSON, add an Environment section listing each key and its value.
Add tests/test_bench_env.py in the style of the existing tests, checking the six keys and that a missing variable maps to unset, using unittest.mock.patch.dict on os.environ.
context: Standard library only. Run from the repo root. Do not change any other behaviour or any file under bench/. Do not commit.
